title: Windows publication tests tolerate a slow first probe
summary: The Windows publication tests in packages/runtime and tools/systems now qualify the temporary drive before any test publishes, retrying a probe the runner was too slow to finish within its bounded 30 s, since the probe caches only a success; each failed attempt is logged. The one CLI call in tools/systems/execute.test.ts that publishes gets the repository's subprocess bound instead of 15 s, which was below its probe's own 30 s. Tests only; the probe and its bound are unchanged.
